Entry = last close · Stop = recent swing low (capped ~3% risk) · Target = greater of 2R or nearest swing high. FA filters: P/E below sector median, revenue growth, debt/equity < 100%, 5yr dividend consistency. Every candidate must be in a confirmed uptrend (20-EMA above 50-EMA, both sloping upward) with MACD at or above its signal line. Additional TA triggers: RSI turn from oversold, MACD cross, volume surge. Rel Vol = today's volume ÷ average volume of the prior 20 sessions.
*Ask/Bid is an approximation, not real order-flow data — Yahoo Finance has no bid/ask trade classification, so this proxies buy vs. sell pressure using volume on up-closing days vs. down-closing days over the last 20 sessions. This is a screening tool, not investment advice — verify before sizing any position.
